paragraphs: An E. coli outbreak linked to raw milk cheese is now over [1]. The outbreak caused 18 cases and 9 hospitalizations across 10 states [1]. Family Farmstead Dairy, LLC is recalling Raw milk cheddar cheese due to potential E. coli contamination [2]. The recalled cheese was distributed to stores in Connecticut, Massachusetts, Maryland, New Jersey, New York, Pennsylvania, and Virginia [2].

Multiple Class I recalls were issued this week for serious bacterial contamination [3][4][12][14]. Krasnyi Oktyabr Inc is recalling Starfish Seafood Cold Smoked Norwegian Salmon for Listeria monocytogenes contamination, distributed across multiple states including New York, Massachusetts, Florida, and others [3]. Lidl US TRADING is recalling Gelatelli coffee and vanilla gelato with cookie pieces due to Listeria monocytogenes, sold in the Northeast and Mid-Atlantic [4]. Fresh & Ready Foods LLC expanded its recall to include Fresh to You brand Sausage, Egg & Cheese Biscuit Sandwiches and Meals Made in Minutes brand Biscuit & Sausage Gravy due to possible Listeria contamination [14].

Additional recalls include WinCo Foods Hoagie Rolls for undeclared sesame distributed in Western states [6], House Foods America seitan cubes for missing wheat allergen labeling distributed nationwide [8], and Naia Chocolate Banana Bar Sorbetto for undeclared tree nuts, milk, and eggs [16]. ALDI is recalling Priano Protein Carbonara Tortelloni and Priano Protein Herb & Cheese Tortelloni because improper temperature storage may have allowed pathogenic growth [15]. Two new Salmonella Enteritidis outbreaks are under FDA investigation, affecting 31 people in one outbreak and 14 in another [33].
